title: Cost optimisation in meal production
context: A project synopsis for the Akshaya Patra Foundation's mid-day meal kitchen in Jaipur.
summary: I scoped a project to find where money is lost in producing and delivering Akshaya Patra's mid-day meals, piloted in the Jaipur kitchen. The synopsis sets out the why, where, when, who and how, and estimates what a 5% saving per meal would be worth.
points: Akshaya Patra serves over 2 million meals a day, so small inefficiencies add up.
Target: a 5% cost reduction per meal over a 6-8 week project.
At 100,000 meals a day and ₹50 a meal, that is ₹250,000 saved daily.

body.p: This project aims to analyse and optimise the costs involved in producing and delivering mid-day meals at the Akshaya Patra Foundation. It will identify inefficiencies and recommend data-driven, practical cost-saving strategies across the meal production supply chain.

list: Akshaya Patra serves over 2 million meals daily, so even minor inefficiencies can lead to significant cost overruns.
Cost savings can be reinvested to reach more children or improve meal quality.
Donors and CSR partners increasingly demand evidence of cost efficiency and impact.

body.p: The project will be piloted in **Jaipur's kitchen** to account for regional cost variations. Insights can later be scaled to other kitchens across India.

head: Weeks
Work
rows: Data collection on the nearest vendors and production capacity
Analysis and identification of cost drivers

list: **Project intern / analyst:** leads the analysis and reporting
**Kitchen operations manager:** provides on-ground insights and data
**Finance and procurement teams:** support access to financial and vendor data
**Mentor / adviser:** from Akshaya Patra's central finance or strategy team
Process mapping of procurement, cooking and logistics
Cost breakdown analysis (raw material, labour, utilities, transport)
Interviews with key staff for qualitative insights
Identifying quick wins, such as bulk procurement and route optimisation
For a kitchen serving 100,000 meals daily at ₹50 a meal, this could mean savings of ₹250,000 per day
Long-term impact: greater efficiency, scalability and donor confidence
